name: Burscheid (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Burscheid (a red crenellated wall above three green leaves on white).
history: Municipal flag of Burscheid; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Burscheid arms — crenellated wall and three leaves
